criteria: 能写出三个比的表达式
理解其值只与角的大小有关
set.description: 在直角三角形中，锐角的正弦、余弦、正切分别是对边比斜边、邻边比斜边、对边比邻边。
set.name: Definitions of Trigonometric Functions of Acute Angles

criteria: Use the correct domains and principal ranges of arcsin and arccos, distinguishing inverse-function notation from reciprocal notation.
Evaluate or solve compositions with sine or cosine by first restricting to the principal range, and verify every returned angle in the original composition.
set.description: Arcsin(t), -1<=t<=1, is the unique angle in [-pi/2,pi/2] with sine t; arccos(t) is the unique angle in [0,pi] with cosine t. Enforce these principal ranges in compositions; unrestricted inverse cancellation is invalid.
set.name: Principal inverse sine and inverse cosine
set.nameZh: 反正弦反余弦的主值分支
